1606 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 05-30: May has 31 days, so days left in May = 1 (May 31 only).  
June 30 days, July 31, August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30, December 31.  

Step: 222 days from 05-30-1606.  
First, 222 - 1 (May 31) = 221 remaining.  
June: 221 - 30 = 191  
July: 191 - 31 = 160  
August: 160 - 31 = 129  
September: 129 - 30 = 99  
October: 99 - 31 = 68  
November: 68 - 30 = 38  
December: 38 - 31 = 7 remaining into next year.  

So date is 1607-01-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1607-01-07
